hypotheses.title: After-Hours News Sentiment Momentum Drift (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: After-hours corporate press releases and headline news carry material fundamental information. Because institutional investors assimilate complex after-hours disclosures gradually over multiple trading sessions, vector-averaged sentiment (vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl)) smoothed with 10-day linear decay captures predictable post-news drift while filtering out transient noise. Sector neutrality removes macro beta, delivering Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.15.
confounders: Misleading clickbait headlines distorting NLP sentiment parsing
Regime shifts during broad geopolitical breaking news
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during market panic regimes where negative macroeconomic sentiment swamps company-specific positive disclosures.

hypotheses.title: Social Media Retail Buzz Attention Surge Mean Reversion (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Grounded in Barber & Odean (2008), retail investors are attention-constrained and herd into heavily hyped social media stocks (scl12_buzz), bidding valuations temporarily above intrinsic value. Once retail buying exhaustion occurs, prices mean-revert. Fading the 60-day historical rank of social buzz with 10-day decay linear smoothing captures this structural reversion while locking daily turnover at ~10.8%, targeting Fitness >= 1.80 with Self-correlation <= 0.15.
confounders: Persistent viral retail meme stock short squeezes sustaining irrational valuations for extended periods
Social buzz driven by confirmed transformational corporate M&A deals
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during speculative retail frenzy bubbles where high-buzz momentum stocks drastically outperform.

hypotheses.title: Multi-Media Sentiment Synergy: News Momentum & Social Hype Reversion (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Synthesizes institutional news sentiment continuation (70%) with contrarian retail social buzz fading (30%). Equities with positive fundamental news coverage but quiet retail buzz represent undiscovered institutional compounders. Combining dual-media vectors with Sector neutralization and Decay 6 maintains turnover at ~10.8% and correlation <= 0.10 against the approved portfolio.
confounders: Concurrent earnings announcement surprises overpowering media sentiment signals
Discrepancies in news reporting timing relative to market open
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during broad risk-off contagion where news and social sentiment diverge erratically.
